solutionSql:
SELECT id, weight_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE status = 'in_transit'
  AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY weight_kg DESC, id ASC
LIMIT 3;
notes: PostgreSQL sorts NULLs first under DESC, so a NULL-weight in_transit row would take a top-three slot. The query excludes NULL weights explicitly. None of the NULL-weight sample rows is in_transit, so the sample result does not depend on that guard.
